verdict.rationale: Eqvista's cap table page claims support for Rule 701 compliance and Form 3921 filing. That is the product's own documented capability for two of the three named items, but it rests on a single marketing sentence with no detail on automatic threshold tracking or generating filings from cap table data. Missing for 10: any evidence of 83(b) election tracking or generation, documentation of automated Rule 701 threshold monitoring, how-to docs showing Form 3921 generation from the cap table, independent or hands-on corroboration.
